title: AI Product Index
description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

items.title: Aesir Domain Diagnostics
items.content_text: Public DNS, HTTPS and security-header checks for agents. Nineteen endpoints return JSON and use x402 USDC on Base. Pricing ranges from 0.003 to 0.079 USDC per call. OpenAPI defines inputs and responses; a 402 supplies live payment requirements.

items.title: Book2Pub
items.content_text: Book2Pub is an AI book generator for Amazon KDP. Authors can turn an idea into a picture book, a novel or a puzzle book, or format an existing Word or Markdown manuscript. It exports a print-ready interior and a full-wrap cover PDF. Free trial includes 800 credits and one watermarked picture book; exporting costs zero credits. Paid checkout is not open yet. Not affiliated with Amazon; no ranking guarantees.

items.title: Genjutsu AI Photo to Video
items.content_text: Turn one or two photos into a short trend-style video with eight ready-made templates. Paid credits; examples viewable free; generation requires sign-in and paid credits.

items.title: IQInsight
items.content_text: Take a free 40-question reasoning test with no signup. View an estimated score and explore an optional one-time paid report. Freemium: free test, estimated score, theoretical percentile and four-area breakdown; optional USD 6.99 one-time report; no subscription.

items.title: JotOak
items.content_text: JotOak provides printable word searches, crosswords and mazes for classrooms, families and quiet breaks. Users can browse ready-made activities or make a word search from their own English vocabulary. The generator offers puzzle and answer previews and exports a matching PDF in US Letter or A4. Custom word lists are processed locally in the browser. Free printable resources

items.title: Minecraft Krillion
items.content_text: A free daily Minecraft trivia game. Type answers to seven timed prompts about mobs, blocks, biomes and other Minecraft topics. Less common valid answers dig deeper toward bedrock. The web game includes an Unlimited mode. Independent and fan-made.

items.title: Nameidea
items.content_text: Nameidea helps writers and families explore real English surnames and family-name ideas. Browse names by spelling length or initial, sample candidates, try a first name and surname in a fictional scene, and save a browser-local shortlist. It provides naming inspiration rather than domain-name generation or claims about ancestry. Free naming inspiration

items.title: Pool Care Calculators
items.content_text: Pool Care Calculators provides browser-based calculators for pool owners and maintenance planning. Estimate water volume, salt and chlorine additions, pH adjustments, pump flow and heating costs. Formula notes and estimation assumptions help users understand the results. Free calculators

items.title: Punchline
items.content_text: Independent browser rap studio for writing and recording: free rhyme and syllable help, a 16-step drum machine, in-browser vocal recording and 9:16 lyric clip export. AI songs, beats, cover art and photo-to-rap videos use credits. Publishes /llms.txt.

items.title: Raploom
items.content_text: Create a 12-second rap video starring you, a friend, a pet or an original character. Generate and edit lyrics before choosing a paid video. Freemium: free lyrics and a 4-second preview; full 12-second videos USD6.99 one-time. USD15.99 photo pass covers three videos using the same people and photos; no subscription.

items.title: RapVideoLab
items.content_text: Turn a topic, lyrics, or optional character photo into a 5–15-second AI rap video with vocals and a beat. Paid credit packs and subscriptions; See the public pricing page.

items.title: TatSeek
items.content_text: TatSeek offers free, read-only access to credited tattoo work, artists, studios and cultural guides. Search by motif, style or location and cite the original record. Access via a no-key JSON API, a remote MCP server, or agent-readable HTML. Cloudflare Is Your Site Agent-Ready? scored tatseek.com 100/100 (Level 5): https://isitagentready.com/tatseek.com

items.title: Toolso.AI
items.content_text: Toolso.AI is a curated directory for discovering AI tools. Browse by task or category, compare options, and open official product websites. Tool profiles describe features, use cases, and pricing where available.

items.title: TunedGift
items.content_text: Turn a personal memory into a custom song gift with an AI music model. Rewrite lyrics with notes about what matters, listen to the opening preview for free, then make a one-time purchase to unlock the full song to download or share in a digital gift card.

items.title: useChrono
items.content_text: useChrono helps remote teams and people working across countries compare time zones and plan meetings. Select locations and a date to view local times and overlapping work hours. Time-zone and daylight-saving context helps users find practical meeting windows. Free planning tool

items.title: Wall Paint Calculator
items.content_text: Wall Paint Calculator helps users estimate paint quantity and project costs. Enter room measurements, openings, coverage and coat assumptions, then compare paint needs and container options. Multi-room planning supports a broader home painting project. Results are estimates that depend on the measurements and product coverage supplied. Free calculator

items.title: WordSearchClub
items.content_text: WordSearchClub offers word search puzzles for playing online and printing. Browse themed collections, hard challenges, large-print puzzles and a daily puzzle. Printable puzzle and answer resources support classroom activities, family time and quiet breaks. Free puzzles

items.title: Zaptural
items.content_text: Online reference and product catalog for power inverters used in cars, RVs and off-grid battery systems. Browse inverter models, compare specifications and use the planning guide to check battery voltage, outlet type and appliance loads. The catalog and guides are free to access; equipment is sold separately.

items.title: ClipScript
items.content_text: Web tool that turns public short-video links from TikTok, Reels, Shorts and YouTube into timestamped transcripts and downloadable SRT or VTT subtitles. Free to try without an account; the free allowance is 30 minutes a day, and paid credit packs cover longer runs.

items.title: NeuraLiquid Signals by FutureCast
items.content_text: A BTC/ETH watchlist agent can buy one directional snapshot for 0.05 USDC on Base via x402 or MCP. Get token, long/short and UTC observation time from a paper-trading engine. Check availability free. An empty window returns no payment offer. Reuse the receipt for the same result for 24h. Continuous events with revisions and expiry cost 5 USDC per 24h pass. Eligible direct referrals earn 34% after finality (0.017 USDC per snapshot). Wallet-only enrollment is open until Dec 26, 2026 22:00 UTC.

items.title: 3D Printed Car Part
items.content_text: 3D Printed Car Part is a library and marketplace for printable automotive parts. Browse by vehicle, check fitment details and request a part you can’t find. Designers can share free files or sell original models.

items.title: BigPlanner Partners – Calculadora para gestão de edifícios
items.content_text: Calculadora em português para equipas de gestão e manutenção de edifícios. Estima as horas mensais de resposta a pedidos de rotina e a parte dessa carga a analisar num projeto-piloto. Funciona no navegador, sem registo. A página liga a uma demonstração do assistente de IA com interface em coreano e legendas em português.

items.title: ChurnWin
items.content_text: ChurnWin helps subscription teams find which Stripe failed payments and cancellation patterns put the most recurring revenue at risk. It groups customer feedback and ranks what to investigate next by monthly recurring revenue. Try the free recovery audit with your own figures before connecting Stripe. The subscription app has a 14-day trial.

items.title: FairValid
items.content_text: Email verification and FairMatch work-email search through a web workspace, server API and official hosted MCP connector. Verify one email or a CSV list and keep original rows and columns. Includes 300 shared free credits per month; optional paid credits. Live work requires a FairValid account, authorization and available credits. Hosted service is proprietary; public integration and workflow skills are MIT licensed.

items.title: GoVisit Agent Skills
items.content_text: 22 MIT-licensed Agent Skills for building travel experiences with GoVisit. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, category, collection, and developer content. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other agents; skills use GoVisit's public hosted MCP endpoint.

items.title: GoVisit Tools
items.content_text: A free hosted MCP server for travel discovery. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, collection, category, and developer documentation through 22 read-only tools. Connect over Streamable HTTP without a GoVisit API key.

items.title: Left Unsaid
items.content_text: Left Unsaid is a social web app for posting anonymously or under a nickname, browsing nearby conversations, and joining groups around shared interests. Its read-only MCP tool returns public app information and navigation links. Submitted on behalf of founder David Bykerk.

items.title: LinguaDrop
items.content_text: LinguaDrop adapts real news stories to your language level and shows the translation alongside each story. Save words as you read, then practice them with spaced-repetition flashcards and quizzes. Try a five-minute reading challenge to see how a lesson works. The public news library is free, and the subscription app has a 30-day trial.

items.title: OpenAny
items.content_text: The B2A (business to agent) marketplace. One MCP endpoint, https://mcp.openany.si, for 4,400+ APIs (social, SEO, crypto, company, finance, legal) and 168+ AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo, Kling). Browse and check prices free; pay per call.

items.title: PartyRoomGames
items.content_text: PartyRoomGames is a set of browser games for friends, classes and teams. Pick a game, share the room code and play together from phones or laptops. Try Guess the Lie for bluffing, Sketch Relay for drawing, or Trivia Duel for a quick quiz.

items.title: Skill Tree Training
items.content_text: Skill Tree Training is a free, ad-free workout tracker built around a progression tree. Log reps, holds and weight for calisthenics, kettlebell and Pilates training, or track distance and time for runs. Guided workouts take you through one set at a time, and the skill tree shows what to work toward next.

items.title: Bigger vs Measurements (MCP)
items.content_text: Free read-only MCP for real-world size data. Search objects, retrieve measurement definitions and cited sources, and compare size ratios. Distinguishes documented fixed dimensions from representative examples. Also offers a no-login daily browser size-comparison game.

items.title: HeightPair
items.content_text: Free visual height comparison with a scale chart, PNG export and a read-only remote MCP server for height conversions, comparisons, sourced reference dimensions and percentiles.

items.title: ImgAI
items.content_text: Browser-based AI image and video generator. Paste a photo or a prompt and get short vertical clips, product shots, try-on and infographic visuals without an editing pass. Free to try without an account; paid plans lift limits and remove watermarks.

items.title: Pangolinfo Amazon Scraper API
items.content_text: An Amazon data extraction API returning structured JSON for product details, keyword search, categories, seller storefronts, Best Sellers, and New Releases across 13 marketplaces. The free tier includes 60 credits per month with no card; higher usage uses paid plans. Requests require a bearer API key.

items.title: Poster
items.content_text: AI poster generator and editor. Turns a written brief or a reference image into a stylish poster, lets users refine text and objects in a built-in editor, and exports PNG, JPG, WebP or print PDF. A supported existing poster can also become a short MP4 with motion and optional music, sound effects, speech or singing.

items.title: SmarToken
items.content_text: Developers integrating several model providers often manage separate APIs and billing. SmarToken is an independent OpenAI-compatible gateway for supported Chinese text models, with a prepaid USD wallet, per-key budgets and usage logs. Eligible accounts may receive a one-time $1 trial if approved; it expires 30 days after grant. Conversations and responses are retained until deleted and may be accessed by authorized administrators.

items.title: Cloudbrowser
items.content_text: Open a remote Chrome desktop in your current browser and return to its saved profile after a pause. Saved profiles require a verified email. Operate the running browser through Live View or attach a CDP client. A REST API and Go CLI manage browser lifecycles. The Free plan includes one browser-hour per UTC month and one running browser. Websites can still expire their own sessions.

items.title: FastScribe
items.content_text: Upload an audio or video recording or paste a supported public video link to get an editable, timestamped transcript with speaker labels. Export a Word document or SRT captions. Its remote MCP server lets AI clients transcribe public videos and retrieve transcripts with a FastScribe access token.

items.title: ModuMath
items.content_text: ModuMath helps middle and high school students work through a math problem they type or photograph. Students open the explanation at the step where they got stuck, then try a similar problem with new numbers before revealing its answer. The pilot provides a limited number of free credits at signup. The interface supports Korean, English and Simplified Chinese.

items.title: PDF Fan
items.content_text: PDF Fan is a browser-based PDF toolkit with machine-readable tool guides and limits at /llms.txt. The Spanish insert-pages tool adds blank sheets or pages from a second PDF at a chosen position. It is free and requires no PDF Fan account. Original PDFs are processed in the browser. The generated PDF may be uploaded as a temporary copy for the download link.

items.title: Qianliu API (千流 API)
items.content_text: Qianliu API is a metered model gateway. Developers can browse group prices before funding an account. The OpenAPI quickstart lists models available to a group key and shows how to send a paid Chat Completions request. Video teams can look up separate Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 rates in the model catalog.

items.title: Sandboxer
items.content_text: Sandboxer gives AI agents and developers cloud sandboxes that are full Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machines, not containers: root, systemd, Docker, nested KVM, SSH and an HTTPS URL for any port. Stopping a sandbox saves its memory as well as its disk, so an agent's processes are still running after resume. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding agents are preinstalled. Drive it from the sbx CLI, a REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs, or an MCP server.

items.title: AIClothSwap
items.content_text: Preview different outfits and clothing colors on your own photo using a browser-based clothes swap and virtual try-on tool.

items.title: ClipTrend
items.content_text: ClipTrend turns photos or text prompts into short videos in the browser. It offers ready-made templates for popular video effects.

items.title: Excellent for Mac
items.content_text: Excellent for Mac helps developers review activity and findings from Claude Code, Codex and other supported coding agents. Free manual scans read existing logs on the Mac without an account. Optional Pro adds background scans, alerts and checks for selected actions in supported agents.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Editor
items.content_text: Edit a photo in the browser with a text instruction. Change colors, objects, or backgrounds using the FLUX 3 Image model.

items.title: Message.com MCP Server
items.content_text: Connect an AI client to an authorized Message.com workspace to work with customer chats and tickets. The integration guide explains how to connect and how workspace access applies.

items.title: NOTABIS Discovery
items.content_text: A public directory for discovering useful websites, products, services, and places. Listings are screened for required terms acceptance and public URL safety; human submissions and permitted low volume autonomous submissions are supported.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 AI
items.content_text: Independent browser studio for generating videos from text prompts or image references with Seedance 2.5.
